    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" name="Does the shipping address differ from the billing address?" default="Flow_BillingAddressSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressMerge" name="Continue after address entry"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="Start_Shopping" targetRef="Task_Login"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginUnsuccessful" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="End_LoginUnsuccessful"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_AddToCart" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddToCart_SaveProduct" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SaveProduct_CheckSelection" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSelection_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllProductsSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderForPreparation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishOrder_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderForPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePayment_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareShipment_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_EnterPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterPayment_SubmitPayment" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitPayment_PaymentAddressSplit" sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentAddressSplit_WaitConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentAddressSplit_EnterShipping" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterShipping_CheckBilling" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAddressDifferent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterBillingAddress_AddressMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressMerge_PaymentAddressJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitConfirmation_PaymentAddressJoin" sourceRef="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentAddressJoin_FinishOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishOrder_End" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineShop" name="Online Shop" processRef="Process_OnlineShop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Payment data"
                      sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Participant_Bank"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OnlineShop">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Shopping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitLoginConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_LoginSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_LoginUnsuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SaveProduct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAllProductsSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AllProductsSelected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPaymentData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitPaymentData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterShippingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBillingAddress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddressMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ShopSystem" name="E-Shop system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCredentials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrderForPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinishOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Shopping" name="Shopping begins"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to the E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitLoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" name="Was the login successful?" default="Flow_LoginUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginUnsuccessful" name="Shopping stops"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected" name="Check whether every product has been selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Have all products been selected?" default="Flow_MoreProducts"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrderForPreparation" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitPaymentData" name="Submit payment data to the bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" name="Wait for payment confirmation while entering address"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" name="Does the shipping address differ from the billing address?" default="Flow_BillingAddressSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address if it differs from the shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressMerge" name="Continue after address entry"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Login" sourceRef="Start_Shopping" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_CheckCredentials" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCredentials_WaitConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Task_WaitLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitConfirmation_LoginGateway" sourceRef="Task_WaitLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccessful" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginUnsuccessful" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccessful" targetRef="End_LoginUnsuccessful"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_AddToCart" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddToCart_SaveProduct" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SaveProduct_CheckSelection" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSelection_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllProductsSelected" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishOrderForPreparation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishOrder_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrderForPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparePayment_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareShipment_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_EnterPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterPayment_SubmitPayment" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitPayment_PaymentAddressSplit" sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentAddressSplit_WaitConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentAddressSplit_EnterShipping" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterShipping_CheckBilling" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAddressDifferent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${shippingAddressDiffersFromBillingAddress}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingAddressSame" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterBillingAddress_AddressMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressMerge_PaymentAddressJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitConfirmation_PaymentAddressJoin" sourceRef="Task_WaitPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentAddressJoin_FinishOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinishOrder_End" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant checks whether a completion condition has been met before the process can proceed: Model the check as a distinct activity performed by that participant, followed by a decision gateway whose condition routes the flow back to the relevant earlier steps or onward when the condition is met.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant checks whether a completion condition has been met before the process can proceed

rules.instruction: When the description states a condition or outcome that a decision assesses: Label the corresponding BPMN gateway with a concise question that identifies that condition or outcome, rather than using a generic participant-response label or substituting a different decision.
rules.situation: the description states two or more distinct decision conditions that govern different branches

rules.instruction: When the description presents activities in an order, states a decision outcome that leads to an activity, or identifies an event that determines what happens next.: Connect each stated transition with a sequence flow, including from the start event to the first activity, from each decision branch to its specified next step, and from an event-based gateway to its catching-event target.
rules.situation: the description states an order, decision outcome, repetition, or dependency between process steps

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity, decision, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with wording that preserves the described action and its object or result; do not substitute a related but different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes an activity, decision, or outcome by its object, responsible actor, or a condition

rules.instruction: When the description qualifies an activity with a condition that distinguishes when it applies or which variant it represents: Include that material qualification in the BPMN activity label so the described distinction remains identifiable; do not use a generic label that omits it.
rules.situation: the description qualifies an activity with a condition that distinguishes when it applies or which variant it represents
